newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 20.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 20.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL
COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers were quoted higher from Thursday's quotes on well-supported cargo prices, traders said.

Bunker 180-cst was traded at $124 per tonne and 380-cst was quoted between at $118-$122. Enquiries were thin as some buyers were sidelined due to the high offers, traders said. MDO and gas oil were at $202-$208 and gas oil at $218-$220.
